cases.customer_question: For HOGP Host implementation, are additional services such as DIS, HIDS, BAS required for qualification?
cases.actual_issue: Misinterpretation of required profiles/services for HOGP Host role due to inconsistencies between specification interpretation and Qualification Workspace test plan behavior.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant verified actual requirements by generating a Test Plan using the Qualification Workspace with correct ICS settings and consistency check (Invalid=0). The result showed that for HOGP Host, only HOGP-related test cases plus a minimal additional test (e.g., SCPP-related CGGIT item) are required. Earlier assumptions about mandatory inclusion of DIS, HIDS, BAS were due to temporary inconsistencies or misinterpretation of tools/spec updates.
cases.final_recommendation: Always validate required profiles and services by generating the Test Plan from the Qualification Workspace using the final ICS. Do not rely solely on specification interpretation or previous listings.
